text:
OH WOW OH WOW LOOK AT THAT BOY!!! 🤩🤩

He’s wearing a SUPER COOL RED JACKET with an ITALIAN FLAG on his arm!! 🇮 And he has jeans that look like they’ve been in mud or something—so FUNNY! 😂

And guess what?? He’s holding a HOCKEY STICK!!! ⛸️ Like, real ones from the ice rink!! But wait—he’s not on ice!! He’s crouching down by this big red net like it’s a GOALIE’S LAIR!! 🕳️⚽ (but for hockey!)

His face is so HAPPY—he’s smiling like he just won the WORLD CUP OF SMILES!! 🌍😄 And one hand is on the ground like “I’m ready to pounce!” and the other is gripping that stick like “Gimme the puck, I got this!”

Is he pretending? Is he practicing? IS HE A SECRET HOCKEY HERO?! 👑🏒

Also… why is there a weird yellow thing behind the net?? Looks like a banana peel or maybe a toy?? 🍌❓ Who left that there?!

THIS IS THE BEST PICTURE EVER. I wanna be him. Or at least borrow his jacket. And maybe try to hit a puck with that stick even if we’re not on ice!! LET’S PLAY HOCK
